payload.title: File:Terrestrisuchus gracilis NHMUK PV R 7557a.jpg
payload.artist_html: Stephan N. F. Spiekman, Vincent Fernandez, Richard J. Butler, Kathleen N. Dollman and Susannah C. R. Maidment
payload.description_html: Terrestrisuchus gracilis NHMUK PV R 7557a (holotype). A, complete slab. B, overview of central region of the slab. C, close up of the cranial and mandibular remains. D, close up of a series of neural arches of dorsal vertebrae and associated osteoderms. Abbreviations: cav, caudal vertebra; de, dentary; dv, dorsal vertebra; fe, femur; fi, fibula; fr, frontal; il, ilium; l., left; mx, maxilla; na, nasal; nea, neural arch; os, osteoderm; pu, pubis; r, radius; r., right; ra, radiale; sa, surangular; sq, squamosal; ti, tibia; u, ulna; ul, ulnare. Scale bars represent: 50 mm (A, B); 10 mm (C, D).
